description: The plot illustrates the relationship between loss and training time for two different models. The x-axis, labeled “Training Time (s)”, is linear, ranging from 0 to 250000 with tick labels at intervals of 50000. The y-axis, labeled “Loss”, is linear, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75 with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. A purple line, marked “Vanilla”, begins at approximately 2.72 at a training time of 0 seconds and decreases to 2.50 at 250000 seconds, with a slight plateau between 100000 and 150000 seconds where the loss remains around 2.62. A red line, marked “SepLLM”, begins at approximately 2.68 at a training time of 0 seconds and decreases to 2.45 at 250000 seconds, with a slight plateau between 100000 and 150000 seconds where the loss remains around 2.58. Both lines are solid and do not contain markers. A horizontal dashed green line is present at a loss value of 2.50, with vertical dashed green lines at approximately 83000 seconds and 250000 seconds.
caption_used: The line plot compares the loss between the vanilla Transformer and the proposed SepLLM model over training time. SepLLM demonstrates a consistently lower loss across all training durations, achieving a final loss of approximately 2.45 at 250,000 seconds, compared to the vanilla model's final loss of 2.50. Additionally, SepLLM exhibits a faster convergence rate, reaching a loss of 2.50 nearly 1.5× faster than the vanilla model, as indicated by the green annotations.
